summary: The base silently executed code after a runtime-conditional return (gfx950 expected [3], observed [9]). Candidate bdbb5574cae5fb9e16febb6dc960c63a6e1bec0c fixes the reported safety problem by issuing a source-located SyntaxError for returns under runtime scf.if/scf.for/scf.while while preserving supported compile-time and nested-function returns.

tests.what_was_measured: Independent original-problem reproduction and boundaries: GPU expected [3] but observed [9], and runtime if/for/while returns were not diagnosed; 4 failed, 3 passed.
Candidate regression coverage for rejection, source location, compile-time returns, and nested functions; 6 passed.
Real-GPU exact integer results for preserved compile-time return semantics and nested dynamic conditionals; 2 passed with rtol=0 and atol=0.
Independent original regression plus adversarial runtime if/for/while, const_expr, nested-function, and import-path boundaries; 7 passed.
Full unit regression suite; 1104 passed, 17 skipped.
Real GPU execution plus retained origin MLIR, lowering stages, LLVM IR, and final gfx950 ISA; 2 passed.

remaining_limitations: Only AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950 was tested; other architectures and operating systems are unverified.
The candidate diagnoses runtime early return rather than implementing divergent exit semantics.
No native rebuild was needed because the candidate contains no C++ or native-extension changes.
